main.description: Returns an indexed Certified profile for each supplied actor DID. Authentication is not required.

actors.description: Actor DIDs to look up, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

profiles.description: One result per supplied actor occurrence, in request order.

actor.description: Actor DID from the corresponding request occurrence.

profile.description: Indexed profile view, or null when none is indexed.
